order_wins: **Pasupati Acrylon** -- allocated 50,745 KL of Denatured Anhydrous Ethanol by BPCL/IOCL/HPCL for ESY 2026-27, estimated value Rs 334 cr (~51.8% of mcap).
**Eppeltone Engineers** (SME) -- Rs 31.41 cr work order for supply, installation, operation and maintenance of Energy Meters (~19.2% of mcap).

**Dev Information Technology** -- two government work orders combined to Rs 17.08 cr (our arithmetic): Vadodara Municipal Corporation (~Rs 15.50 cr IT consulting) and Gujarat Metro Rail Corporation (~Rs 1.58 cr software), (~14.5% of mcap).
**DCX Systems** -- Rs 23.06 cr of domestic/export cable-and-wire-harness orders, plus a separate Rs 2.47 cr export order at wholly-owned subsidiary Raneal Advanced Systems (~1.3% of mcap).

**KD Green Industries** (formerly Manbro Industries) -- 51%-held subsidiary Shivam Pipe Industries secures Rs 6.81 cr of electric-pole orders from Meghalaya and Assam power-distribution utilities (~2.5% of mcap).
**Bharat Electronics** -- receives orders worth Rs 619 cr.
**Bench Mark Infotech Services** -- secures orders worth Rs 66.67 cr from government clients, incl. applicable taxes.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Geetanjali Credit and Capital** -- Rights Issue Committee fixes its already-approved rights issue at Rs 88.38 cr (7,07,07,200 shares at Rs 12.50), 16 new shares for every 1 held, record date 18-Nov (our arithmetic on the filing's two stated figures).
**Ironwood Education** -- submits the Letter of Offer for its already-approved Rs 24 cr rights issue, 34 shares for every 100 held at Rs 41/share, record date 18-Nov.
**Shalimar Paints** -- its QIP Committee opens the issue today at a floor price of Rs 80.87/share (Board approved 12-Aug, shareholders 11-Sep); aggregate size not stated in today's filing.
**KP Green Engineering** -- Board approves a preferential issue of up to 34,24,657 convertible warrants at Rs 292 each (~Rs 100 cr, our arithmetic), subject to shareholder approval.
equity_allotments: **P.M. Telelinnks** (SME) -- allots 1,50,00,000 equity shares at Rs 10/share (Rs 15 cr) to four non-promoter funds.
**Imagicaaworld Entertainment** -- Board approves a Rs 16.25 cr preferential issue of convertible warrants to a non-promoter, subject to EGM approval 11-Dec.
**Sobhagya Mercantile** -- Board recommends a 10:1 bonus issue (filed twice, NSE+BSE), subject to EGM and an Authorised Capital increase to Rs 150 cr.
m_and_a: **Relaxo Footwears** -- Board approves a Kenya footwear-manufacturing JV (51% stake, up to Rs 35.70 cr) with the Kenafric Group, via definitive agreements incl. an asset transfer from the Kenafric side (~0.5% of mcap).

**Archean Chemical Industries** -- signs a non-binding MoU with the Andhra Pradesh Economic Development Board on an indicative Rs 2,000 cr battery energy-storage giga-factory (up to 5 GWh/yr), via a proposed SPV; not a firm commitment.

**Blue Jet Healthcare** -- signs a non-binding MoU with the Andhra Pradesh Economic Development Board on a phase-wise API manufacturing facility, indicative investment up to Rs 500 cr on 50 acres; valid 12 months, not a firm commitment.

**Money Masters Leasing & Finance** -- a new promoter group buys a 34.66% controlling stake via an SPA (Rs 3.48 cr at Rs 1/share) alongside a fresh Rs 3.35 cr preferential issue to the same allottees (our arithmetic, Rs 6.83 cr combined); triggers a mandatory SEBI SAST open-offer obligation (~44.4% of mcap).
**Pricol** -- promoters execute an SPA to sell a 38.51% stake in subsidiary Pricol Autotech to Topaz Terrace Investments, a Warburg Pincus affiliate; price not disclosed in the cached text.
**Fusion CX** -- UK subsidiary Fusion BPO Services acquires Germany's impacx solutions, tel-inform solutions and impacx services; price not disclosed in the cached text.
**Eiko Lifesciences** and **Oval Projects Engineering** -- each reports the 12-Nov incorporation of their 50:50 joint venture, Oval Eiko Resources Private Limited; no capital figure stated.
**Adani Energy Solutions** -- completes its 100% acquisition of Intellismart Infrastructure from NIIF and EESL (SPA executed 9-Jun-2026) after CCI clearance; price not restated in today's filing.
**Belrise Industries** -- Board approves a scheme amalgamating H-One India into Belrise, rescinding a prior scheme approved 11-Nov-2025; no financial terms stated.

**Manipal Health Enterprises** -- completes its acquisition of Kinder Women's Hospital and Fertility Centre, Bengaluru (Business Transfer Agreement executed 17-Aug-2026); price not restated in today's filing.
**Sizemasters Technology** -- Board approves divesting its entire 55% capital contribution from Aurum Turnkey Services LLP; no consideration stated.
**Amwill Health Care** -- signs an Exclusive Manufacturing, Private Label Supply, Import and Non-Disclosure Agreement with a Thailand pharma manufacturer; financial terms not disclosed.
**Linde India** -- Board approves and executes an SPA to acquire 100% of Airtech Cryogenic Gases; price not disclosed in the cached text.
**Precot** -- Board gives in-principle approval to pursue a demerger of identified non-core assets via a Scheme of Arrangement, subject to NCLT and shareholder approval; no further detail yet.
**EID Parry India** -- Board approves the slump sale of its Sivagangai Distillery Unit as a going concern via a Business Transfer Agreement; consideration not disclosed in the cached text.
capex_core: **Steelcast** -- approves a further Rs 31 cr capacity addition (3,250 tons) at its Greenfield Foundry, on top of an already-approved Rs 120 cr/8,500-ton expansion (29-Jul) -- cumulative investment now Rs 151 cr (only the Rs 31 cr increment is today's news).
**Godawari Power and Ispat** -- wholly-owned subsidiary GNEPL allots Rs 50 cr of preference shares to GPIL (rights basis) to fund its Battery Energy Storage System plant.

**Kovilpatti Lakshmi Roller Flour Mills** -- Board approves capex for upgradation/modernisation of equipment at its Coimbatore engineering division; estimated cost not legible in the cached (OCR) text.
business_updates: **Results season** — 768 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.
**Eicher Motors** -- best-ever Q2: consolidated revenue Rs 7,422 cr (+20% YoY), EBITDA Rs 1,760 cr (+16%), PAT Rs 1,573 cr (+15%); Royal Enfield sales +15% YoY, VECV sales +28.2% YoY.
**ABB India** -- Q3 CY2026: record orders +56% YoY, order backlog Rs 12,927 cr (+36%), revenue +19%, operational EBITA/PAT +15%/+10%.
**CMS Info Systems** -- fourth straight record-services-revenue quarter: Q2FY27 services revenue Rs 644 cr (+16.2% YoY), EBITDA Rs 173 cr (+24.8%), PAT Rs 81 cr (+10.3%).
**Orient Cables (India)** -- H1FY27 standalone revenue DOUBLES YoY to Rs 1,018 cr, EBITDA +155% to Rs 119.2 cr, PAT +194% to Rs 73.7 cr -- the day's strongest growth print.
**Innova Captab** -- Q2FY27 consolidated revenue Rs 496.3 cr (+30.5% YoY), EBITDA Rs 72.4 cr (+29.2%), PAT Rs 42.4 cr (+43.0%).

**Frog Innovations** (formerly Frog Cellsat) -- H1FY27 revenue Rs 64.5 cr (+17.4% YoY), turnaround to PAT of Rs 0.87 cr; references a Letter of Intent from Indus Towers (Rs 91.97 cr, Delhi Metro DAS) not yet an award.
**P N Gadgil Jewellers** -- Diwali festive-season sales Rs 689 cr, +14% YoY (gold +13%, silver +24%, diamond +8%).
**TAKE** -- H1FY27 consolidated Total Income Rs 61.55 cr (our arithmetic, USD/mn to cr: Rs 615.54 million as printed).
**CSM Technologies** -- H1FY27 Total Income Rs 86.28 cr, Q2 Total Income Rs 43.04 cr.
**Oswal Pumps** -- Q2FY27 Total Income Rs 511.8 cr, DOWN 6.4% YoY (+6.2% QoQ); EBITDA down 53.4% YoY, PAT down 59.4% YoY.
distress_risk: **Rane Holdings** -- subsidiary Rane Steering Systems receives a GST order dropping a Rs 11.88 cr demand (incl. penalty) in entirety.
open_offers: **Shree OSFM E-Mobility Limited** — S FLYWINGS SIMULATOR TRAINING CENTRE LIMITED open offer for 26.0% (40.05 lakh shares) at Rs 61 vs CMP 60.45 (+0.9%); change of control (Reg 4) + >25% acquisition (Reg 3(1)); intends to DELIST; **TENDER - offer above market**; tender window not in PA (comes with DPS/LoF); mcap Rs 93 cr
credit_rating_changes: **Vishal Nirmiti** -- Infomerics upgrades bank-facility ratings to IVR BBB+/Stable (long-term) and IVR A2 (short-term), on a reduced Rs 115 cr facility (from Rs 120.80 cr).

**Onida Electronics** (formerly MIRC Electronics) -- Infomerics reaffirms its BB bank-facility and NCD ratings but revises the outlook to Negative from Stable, on Rs 177 cr bank facilities and Rs 48 cr NCDs.
**E2E Networks** -- ICRA upgrades to [ICRA] A (Positive) from [ICRA] A- (Stable) on its term-loan facilities.
**Asian Hotels (East)** -- India Ratings assigns a fresh IND BBB+/Stable to Rs 165 cr of bank-loan facilities.
**Sai Life Sciences** -- India Ratings upgrades the credit rating on its bank-loan facilities.
other_notable: **Choice International Ltd** — Intimation of the 1st Extra Ordinary General Meeting of the Company for the Financial Year 2026-27 scheduled to be held on Saturday, December 05, 2026 at 12:00 Noon via Video Conferecing/ other Audio

**Shiv Aum Steels Limited** — Shiv Aum Steels Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 13, 2026, has considered and approved subdivision of 1 equity shares of Rs. 10 each into 6
**Hypersoft Technologies Ltd** — Attached Intimation of Approval of Stock Split by the Board subject to approval of Shareholders
